intent: A type-specimen-style sheet of eleven refined buttons in three sizes, doubling as a copy-paste button system with split, loading, magnetic and hold-to-confirm patterns.

stack.fonts: font-display (Bricolage Grotesque), font-serif (Instrument Serif), font-sans (Geist), font-mono (Geist Mono)

layout.masthead: mono row on a 1px solid ink rule: kicker left, edition right
layout.header: 12-col grid: headline 8 cols, intro 4 cols bottom-aligned
layout.table: grid minmax(0,15rem) + 3 x minmax(0,1fr), gap-x 24px; column heads Small 32/13, Medium 40/14, Large 48/15
layout.row: two-digit mono index, display name 19px, 13px note; 1px rule at 10% ink; py 28px

motion.loading: label opacity 0, spinner absolutely centred; width unchanged
motion.magnetic: button follows pointer x0.32, label a further x0.22; springs stiffness 260 damping 18 mass 0.6; mouse only
motion.hold: clip-path reveal of a solid copy, 1200ms linear; release rewinds over 350ms; resets 2.2s after completion
motion.reducedMotion: no magnetic movement; menu fades only

responsive.mobile: column heads hidden; specimens wrap in a flex row indented 40px with mono size captions

accessibility: native buttons with type=button and visible focus-visible rings
icon-only buttons carry aria-label; icons aria-hidden
loading sets aria-busy and announces through a polite live region
split trigger: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls; menuitemradio with roving tabindex, arrows/Home/End/Esc
hold-to-confirm works with Space/Enter held; accessible name explains the gesture; completion announced assertively

content.title: Buttons, / pressed with care.
